The caveat says "who were not re-tested or whose re-test was not the highest sequence" which is contradictory. But that's a minor wording issue, not a data problem. Also they didn't mention potential imbalance due to non-random arm assignment, but not relevant to mean baseline. No missing data besides -999 handled. So no unacknowledged problems.

5. FALSE PREMISE: Premises: there are patients with SEVERE disease (true) and -999 are not valid (true). So fine.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
